title: Decoding NF-kappaB: nucleocytoplasmic shuttling dynamics, synthetic modulation and post-therapeutic behavior in cancer.
authors: Alhallaq, Ahmed S; Sultan, Nadeen S
one_liner_zh: 综述NF-kappaB核质穿梭动态与合成调控，涉及蛋白-DNA互作但缺乏AI/物理模拟建模，方法学深度不足。
abstract: Nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB) has been extensively investigated for approximately four decades. Throughout this timeframe, significant progress has been accomplished in determining the structure, function, and regulation of NF-kappaB; however, some nuanced complexities of this fundamental signaling pathway remain underexplored. A notable gap exists in the spatiotemporal regulation and molecular dynamics of NF-kappaB nucleocytoplasmic shuttling, which significantly impacts the complex function and behavior, yet lacks comprehensive characterization. The nucleocytoplasmic shuttling process is also related to resistance mechanisms that evolved following the application of NF-kappaB or proteasomal inhibitors. Furthermore, the NF-kappaB complex has a stochastic variability in its trafficking that contributes to heterogeneous cellular responses at the single-cell level and lacks a well-defined druggable pocket, making its complete suppression in cancer cells challenging and uncertain. Engineering synthetic gene circuits and utilizing optogenetic tools can pave the way for precise control of the NF-kappaB complex, enabling advanced investigations into NF-kappaB regulation and post-therapeutic behavior implicated in cancer resistance. This approach also permits tumor microenvironment (TME)-immune modulation by synthetic gene circuits that reactivate immune cells within the TME. In this review, we discussed the structure and function of NF-kappaB, the molecular dynamics of NF-kappaB nucleocytoplasmic shuttling based on established findings, NF-kappaB engineering via synthetic biology tools, and critically deciphered the post-therapeutic behavior of NF-kappaB in cancer, supported by potential therapeutic targets to abrogate resistance.
abstract_zh: 核因子kappa B（NF-kappaB）已被广泛研究了约四十年。在此期间，在确定NF-kappaB的结构、功能和调控方面取得了显著进展；然而，这一基本信号通路的一些细微复杂性仍未得到充分探索。NF-kappaB核质穿梭的时空调控和分子动力学方面存在显著空白，这对其复杂功能和行为有重要影响，但缺乏全面表征。核质穿梭过程也与应用NF-kappaB或蛋白酶体抑制剂后演化的耐药机制相关。此外，NF-kappaB复合物在其运输中具有随机变异性，这导致单细胞水平上的异质性细胞反应，并且缺乏明确的药物结合口袋，使其在癌细胞中的完全抑制具有挑战性和不确定性。工程化合成基因回路并利用光遗传学工具可为精确控制NF-kappaB复合物铺平道路，从而实现对NF-kappaB调控及癌症耐药中治疗后行为的高级研究。该方法还允许通过合成基因回路进行肿瘤微环境（TME）-免疫调节，以重新激活TME内的免疫细胞。在本综述中，我们讨论了NF-kappaB的结构和功能、基于已有发现的NF-kappaB核质穿梭的分子动力学、通过合成生物学工具进行的NF-kappaB工程化，并批判性地解读了NF-kappaB在癌症中的治疗后行为，同时提出了消除耐药的潜在治疗靶点。
